task1.title: Percentage of five kinds of books sold, 1972-2012
task1.prompt: The pie charts below show the percentage of five kinds of books sold by a bookseller between 1972 and 2012.

chartDesc.overview: Adult fiction saw a dramatic rise over the 40-year period, growing to account for half of all book sales by 2012, while all other categories except Children's fiction experienced declines.
keyFeatures: Adult fiction expanded significantly from 20% in 1972 to 35% in 1992 and reached 50% in 2012.
Children's fiction showed modest growth, rising steadily from 20% in 1972 to 22% in 1992 and 25% in 2012.
Travel book sales declined continuously from 15% in 1972 to 13% in 1992 and 5% in 2012.
Biography sales dropped by more than half, falling from 20% in 1972 to 10% in 1992 and 8% in 2012.
Others declined from the largest category in 1972 (25%) down to 12% in 2012.

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

task2.title: Age at which children should start school
task2.prompt: Some people believe that children should start school at a very early age, while others think they should not go to school until they are older. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
task2.instruction: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
